description: The agent for run.finished events: agent, else parsed from run_id (backfills events sent before the agent field existed).
model_calls / reserved_calls on run.finished: 1.0 means the run used its whole reservation.
1 for a successful run.finished, else 0: AVG(run_ok) is the success rate.
The model an event is about: the failing model for factory.model_retry, else the chat span's gen_ai.request.model (factory.model_id on spans is the run's primary model and wrong after a switch).
1 when the factory PR was merged, 0 when closed unmerged: AVG over pr.closed is the completion rate.
1 when the factory PR was merged without a revise round: AVG over pr.closed is the accepted-without-revision rate.
tick.decision reason without the per-issue detail (no_eligible_feature (#107:...) -> no_eligible_feature); the kind (dispatch, mark_lost) when there is no reason.
